$comment: The Playwright releases images.yml builds the browser sandbox image for (issue #315), each tagged <release>-playwright-<version> and recorded by digest. Each release names its lockfile folder (npm ci checks every package against its integrity hash) and the Chrome Headless Shell its playwright-core's browsers.json names, with the sha256 of each architecture's archive (checked by the Dockerfile with sha256sum -c). The default is the one the Dockerfile's ARG defaults build; it is also tagged <release> and, for a stable release, latest. playwright_matrix.py checks this file and prints the workflow's matrix. Adding a release: docs/design/EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT.md.
